sections.label: Species
sections.description: Which species' decay is being edited. Switching keeps each species' edits; OK writes them all back.

sections.title: Lifetime spectrum
sections.description: Amplitude and lifetime (ns) of each exponential component of this species' decay.

columns.title: Amplitude
columns.description: Relative amplitude of the component (negative = rise term).

columns.title: Lifetime (ns)
columns.description: Fluorescence lifetime of the component in ns; components with tau <= 0 are skipped.

buttons.label: Add
buttons.description: Add a lifetime component (amplitude 1, lifetime 1 ns).

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected lifetime component (the last one if none is selected).

buttons.label: Clear pattern
buttons.description: Drop the decay-pattern file so this species uses its lifetimes again.

sections.label: Decay pattern file
sections.description: Measured or saved decay pattern (.npy or text) that replaces the lifetimes for this species; empty = use the lifetimes.

sections.label: Gaussian FWHM (ns)
sections.description: Full width at half maximum of the Gaussian instrument response shared by all species; 0 = no IRF convolution.
Live preview of this species' micro-time decay on the simulator's TAC axis.
